cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

mechanism: A controls the order of testimony so B must acknowledge the impossible observation before A admits acting on belief.
confusable: Unlike merely comparing observations, A reserves A's more committed behavior until B confirms the shared event.
comparison: A shadow reaching a door differs from a noodle asking to be fed.
seedUse: The seed already defers B's question and demands B's account first, giving S01 a concrete disclosure-order tactic.
